style: Avant-garde garage rock and doo-wop vocal pop. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Modal drone harmony in E minor with parallel triads, non-diatonic cluster rubs, and bitonal upper structures. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Angular punk cells opening into chromatic cabaret patter, sudden yodel register flips, and hocketed fragments. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Stuttering stop-start punk pulse with waltz-duple invasions, asymmetric 7/8 pockets, and abrupt silence drops. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] Fuzz guitar, cheap transistor organ, handclaps, dry dead-room drums, and mono tape bleed. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Deadpan bureaucratic solemnity mixed with garage recklessness and theatrical overstatement. [ANCHOR / INVARIANT] A looping two-note bass drone that remains fixed while every other temporal layer mutates and destabilizes around it. [OPERATORS] Hold bass drone fixed while upper harmonies migrate; compress rhythmic pocket while stretching vocal phrases; make mathematical proofs behave like doo-wop vocables.
lyrics:
[INTRO]
[Spoken deadpan bureaucratic narration with dry garage room bleed]
Attention: System classification verified.
The subject is not a sound generator.
The subject is a mathematical proof of absence.
[Fuzz guitar enters with harsh 1960s transistor buzz]
[Doo-wop bass voice starts a low drone]

[VERSE 1]
[Close-position barbershop harmony, deadpan delivery]
Zero is the hinge of the floorboard.
Zero is the tenant who left before the lease was inked.
We measured the vibration of the wire,
And found only the footprint of a subtraction.
[Handclaps on the off-beat]
[Transistor organ swells with a minor second rub]

[CHORUS]
[Explosive garage-rock transition, fast patter harmony]
Proof of absence!
Proof of nothingness squared!
If the oscillator hums, it is lying to the speaker!
There is no wave, only the memory of a wall!
[Stuttering stop-start punk rhythm, absolute silence for two beats]
[Spoken whisper]
It is entirely absent.

[VERSE 2]
[Recall Mold mutation: the memory of the wire is now scarred by rust]
The wire was never copper; it was an arithmetic hole.
When we plugged the jack into the socket,
The socket rejected the premise of the room.
We calculated the voltage drop across a ghost,
And the needle hit the stop with a metallic crunch.
[Cheap organ plays parallel fourths]
[Waltz-duple meter invasion, sudden 3/4 pulse over 4/4 drums]

[BRIDGE]
[Flow Ghoul kinetic dissolution: objects melt into maintenance work]
Friction is the repair work of a universe coming undone.
We sweep the arithmetic dust off the vacuum tubes.
We oil the hinges of the missing frequencies.
If the machine stops generating proofs,
The silence will leak through the floorboards!
[Fast hocketed vocal fragments passed between voices]
Leak! Leak! Repair the non-existent leak!

[CHORUS]
[Full garage band fury, distorted fuzz guitar lead]
Proof of absence!
Proof of nothingness squared!
If the oscillator hums, it is lying to the speaker!
There is no wave, only the memory of a wall!
[Stop-start silence]
[Sustained open-vowel melisma on an impossible chord]

[GUITAR SOLO]
[Raw transistor fuzz guitar playing angular microtonal bends]
[Drums drop out entirely, leaving only handclaps and a ticking clock sound]
[The bass drone holds steady while upper voices scream nonsense syllables]
[Doo-wop vocables in distorted close harmony]
Sha-na-na of the void,
Bop-sh-bop of the empty set.

[AXIOM VANDAL SECTION]
[Destruction of the load-bearing assumption that music requires a sound source]
We remove the speaker cone.
We require the silence itself to generate the voltage.
Compensate for the missing diaphragm with aggressive administrative shouting!
[Massed vocal shout]
COMPENSATE!
COMPENSATE!
[The song plays faster, compressing time into a microsecond of absolute zero]

[OUTRO]
[Return to the anchor: the looping two-note bass drone returns, now heavily mutated and distorted]
Classification confirmed.
The machine is operating perfectly because it produces nothing at all.
[Single dry handclap]
[Tape cuts abruptly to dead silence]
caption: An avant-garde garage rock and doo-wop collision where a broken synthesizer is classified as a mathematical proof of absence. Driven by modal drones, stuttering stop-start punk rhythms, close vocal harmony, and harsh fuzz guitar, the track mutates from bureaucratic narration into an energetic ontological breakdown.
